notes.title: Inutoneko Character Popularity Poll & Discount for all Inutoneko games(Repaired)
notes.content:
[i][h3]The voting website has been repaired.[/h3][/i]

The first international Inutoneko 'Harekumo' series [b]character popularity poll[/b] is coming!
Vote for your favorite character from these cute characters in the 'Harekumo' series!

Coming up with our biggest discount for all Inutoneko games during [b]April 30th ~ May 14th[/b]!

Voting date: [b]April 30th ~ May 14th[/b]
(One person, one vote)

[url=https://harevote2021.starshipstudio.net/]Voting Address: https://harevote2021.starshipstudio.net/[/url]
Visit the following address to vote and leave your email address for a chance to get a Steam edition of all Inutoneko games (10 in total)!
